note: Dailymotion v2 error code -> what the app does. Data, not code: an API change edits this file. Source: developers.dailymotion.com reference/api-errors + operation pages (read 2026-11-15). Classes: expired (new token once) · blocked (stop the run, a person fixes) · breaker (stop at once, a person looks) · rate (wait Retry-After once, else stop the day) · failed (this pair only) · retry (transient).
